requirements.text: Start-up bidder should be recognized by DPIIT with a Certificate of Recognition as a Start-up
Start-up entity should not be more than 10 years since the date of incorporation
Turnover of the start-up should not have been greater than Rs. 100 crores from the year of commencement
FinTech / Digital Capability Partner should have a minimum net worth of Rs.100 lakh
FinTech / Digital Capability Partner should have been incorporated in India for at least two years
Bidder must comply with Public Procurement orders under O.M. No. 6/18/2019-PPD dated 23.07.2020
Bidder should not be under debarment or blacklist by any Scheduled Commercial Bank, PSU or Government agency
Consortium bidding, sub-contracting and joint assignments are not allowed
Performance Security Bank Guarantee of 5% of the agreement value valid for contract tenure plus three months
Services available with an uptime of 99.99% on a 24 x 7 basis for 365 days in a year
All video KYC data shall be stored within Indian jurisdiction, encrypted at rest and in transit
Video stream should be end-to-end encrypted and protected against interception
The solution shall be ISO 27001 and ISO 27018 certified
Closure of all VAPT / Information Security audit observations within the time frame stipulated by the Bank at no additional cost
Vendor shall maintain a Source Code Escrow arrangement for proprietary software components
Liquidated damages of 0.5% of total Project Cost per week of delay up to a maximum of 5% of total Project Cost
Contract to be signed and Bank Guarantee submitted within 30 days from issuance of Purchase Order
